name: Fuel gas booster / compressor for low supply pressure to burners
description: Raises incoming utility gas pressure to the net regulated pressure required at the burner gas-train inlet when mains pressure is insufficient; packaged skids combine a hermetically sealed centrifugal blower, check valve, inlet/outlet pressure switches, isolating valves, gauges and a factory control panel, usually installed just downstream of the gas meter. Selection basis: gas flow = burner firing rate / calorific value; pressure lift = minimum required burner pressure minus available mains pressure.
